description: Export the active document to PDF using a built-in or named PDF export preset

includeBleed.description: Force the document bleed settings on (otherwise the preset decides)

includeMarks.description: Force crop, bleed and registration marks, color bars and page info on (otherwise the preset decides)

pages.description: Pages to export: "all", or absolute 1-based page numbers/ranges such as "1-3,5"

preset.description: Exact PDF export preset name (e.g. "[PDF/X-4:2008]"); overrides quality

quality.description: Preset shortcut: PRESS = [Press Quality], PRINT = [High Quality Print], SCREEN = [Smallest File Size]

name: export_pdf
title: Export PDF
